answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Each submission hangs on the lagoon of a task receipt, and the zephyr is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a user experience perspective, adoption barriers register, it stays short. By the reef of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on cryptographic attestation with threshold signatures.
